name: fairgames-cancelled-bloomberg-nov-11
headline: إلغاء لعبة Fairgame$
line:
وفق بلومبرغ (Bloomberg):
سوني (Sony) ألغت اللعبة
بعد اختبار لم يبلغ الأهداف
label: تقرير

angle.hook: A game announced three years ago at a PlayStation Showcase will now never release
angle.why_now: Bloomberg published the internal email on 10 November, and Sony's spokesperson commented the same day
angle.what_it_means_here: Another PlayStation live service shooter ends before launch, though Haven Studios stays open and moves to support other teams, and Sony has not published a statement of its own
